invocation.output: an OS temporary directory outside the entry (verify never writes into the entry)

failure_modes_match: exact: run.json failure_modes must equal this list
note: The Reason vocabulary has no dedicated stale reason. A recorded digest that no longer matches the file on disk is a source mismatch, so the intended reason is SOURCE_MISMATCH; the category is carried by the failure mode STALE_DEPENDENCY. ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 names only the failure mode.

recorded_run.informational: These values depend on the tool version and are recorded for reference; they are not part of the expected outcome.

does_not_prove: Matching these results shows conformance on declared fixtures only. It does not show scientific validity, detection of failures outside this corpus, or fitness for use.
